make_options_from_settings: construct a dict of configuration options for named observables using make_options with ObservationSettings and ObservableNames
create_ObservableSpec: create an ObservableSpec namedtuple with enabled, update_interval, buffer_size, delay, aggregator, and corruptor fields
create_CameraObservableSpec: create a CameraObservableSpec namedtuple with height, width, and all ObservableSpec fields for camera observables
create_ObservationSettings: create an ObservationSettings namedtuple grouping ObservableSpecs by proprio, ftt, prop_pose, and camera categories
create_ObservableNames: create an ObservableNames namedtuple grouping observable names by proprio, ftt, prop_pose, and camera categories
